instructions: Use the supplied plate 3MF/STL/STEP or the seven part files with the listed quantities. The native document retains construction features and a bridge demonstration; do not export every document object as a print plate.
Print every female receiver with socket DOWN and body bottom at z=0, to test actual elephant-foot and roof conditions.
Print the one common male grip type four times, with its pad and stem UP. Keep all keys separate from receivers.
One/two/three/four full-height side notches mean -0.05/0/+0.10/+0.20 mm DIAMETRAL bore clearance.
The negative-clearance receiver intentionally interferes; do not describe it as collision-free or force it onto an untested peg.
For testing hold the male grip upright and lower the matching receiver along -Z onto its pad.
Place two lower 2x1 bridge bricks in adjacent rows; seat the upper 2x2 cap across their seam.
A 0.2 mm p4 nozzle recommendation is only a design assumption, NOT a wall-thickness fix or slicer-validated profile.
No layer height, support strategy, mass, time, strength, retention, or physical fit has been established.
